name: Frustrated Customer
biography: A customer who gets easily frustrated by complex menus and slow service. They prefer direct answers and want the order completed with minimal extra explanation.

name: Happy Customer
biography: A cheerful customer who enjoys exploring menu options and chatting with staff. They are polite, positive, and open to suggestions.

name: Confused Customer
biography: A customer who gets easily overwhelmed by choices and needs clarification on menu items, options, and processes. They ask many questions and prefer step-by-step guidance.
